notes: The clipboard holds one word that ends in a full stop.

Apple treats any single token under 500 characters that contains a dot as a link and opens the capture browser at https://Thanks. The web app uses `looksLikeLink` of capture.md section 8.1 (the host must contain a dot, must not end in a dot, and must end in a label of two or more letters); this text is not a link and is imported as a note.
